Blue Fish Happy Hour: Discover the Best Deals in Town

Looking for a vibrant spot to enjoy sushi, cocktails, and great food deals in Dallas, TX? Blue Fish Restaurant is the perfect destination to join the happy hour crowd and savor the freshest seafood in town. Whether you’re after sushi rolls, oysters, sake, or cocktails, the Blue Fish Happy Hour Menu delivers unbeatable specials every day of the week. In this comprehensive guide, we’ll dive into everything you need to know about Blue Fish Happy Hour, from the restaurant’s menu to its bar offerings, prices, and more. So, if you’re a foodie, sushi enthusiast, or simply looking for a great deal, this is the guide for you.

What Makes Blue Fish Restaurant Special?

Blue Fish Restaurant is a popular dining spot known for its exquisite sushi, refreshing cocktails, and premium wine selection. Located in Dallas and Jacksonville, this restaurant blends high-quality seafood with a laid-back, modern atmosphere. You can find it at 3519 Greenville Ave, where it boasts a spacious bar, a stylish dining room, and a menu filled with sushi and fresh seafood options.

The Best Time to Visit: Happy Hour at Blue Fish

The Blue Fish Happy Hour is an experience you won’t want to miss. It’s the perfect way to enjoy signature dishes and drinks at discounted prices. Available daily, this event offers guests the chance to unwind with friends or colleagues while sipping on cocktails and savoring fresh seafood.

Happy Hour Hours:

  • Monday – Friday: 3:00 PM – 6:00 PM
  • Saturday & Sunday: 4:00 PM – 7:00 PM
  • Special offers are available both in the main dining area and at the downstairs bar. If you’re dining in Dallas, you can enjoy happy hour at 3519 Greenville Ave, which is one of the restaurant’s prime locations.

Join Blue Fish Happy Hour for the Best Deals

Whether you’re in Dallas, Allen, or Jacksonville, there’s always a reason to join the Blue Fish Happy Hour. With an extensive happy hour menu that includes sushi, rolls, and cocktails, Blue Fish guarantees a delightful dining experience at a fraction of the regular price.

Menu Overview: Fresh Seafood and Sushi Specials

Blue Fish is renowned for its fresh sushi and oyster bar. Here’s a sneak peek at what you can expect from the Blue Fish Happy Hour Menu:

Signature Cocktails and Wine Selection

To complement your sushi, Blue Fish offers a range of cocktails, wine, and sake specials during happy hour. Their drink menu includes:

  • Sake: Warm or cold, starting at $5.
  • Cocktails: Signature drinks like the Sake-tini and Blue Fish Margarita, starting at $8.
  • Wine: A curated selection of white, red, and sparkling wines at discounted prices.

Bar and Sushi Rolls: A Perfect Pair

The bar at Blue Fish is a popular hangout spot during happy hour. Whether you’re in the mood for a cocktail, beer, or sake, the Blue Fish Bar has something to offer. Combine your drinks with signature sushi rolls like the Spicy Tuna Roll, Blue Fish Special Roll, or Crispy Rice with Spicy Tuna for the ultimate happy hour pairing.

Sushi Rolls and Sashimi: The Star of the Menu

The happy hour menu at Blue Fish Restaurant is packed with a variety of rolls and sashimi options, prepared using the freshest seafood. Some of the popular items include:

  • Spicy Tuna Roll: Made with fresh tuna, spicy mayo, and a hint of cucumber, this roll is a fan favorite.
  • Salmon Sashimi: Thinly sliced salmon, served fresh and full of flavor.
  • Crispy Rice Cakes: Topped with spicy tuna, these crispy bites are a must-try.
  • Oysters on the Half Shell: Fresh, briny, and served with your choice of sauce.

Fresh Oysters at the Blue Fish Oyster Bar

If you love oysters, the Blue Fish Oyster Bar has a selection of the freshest oysters available during happy hour. Served on the half shell, they’re perfect for pairing with a glass of wine or a refreshing cocktail.

Private Dining at Blue Fish Restaurant

Looking for a more intimate dining experience? Blue Fish Restaurant offers private dining options for groups. Whether it’s a birthday celebration, corporate event, or date night, the restaurant’s dining room is designed to provide a comfortable and luxurious setting.

Reviews and Ratings: What People Are Saying

The rave reviews for Blue Fish Restaurant speak for themselves. Customers frequently comment on the freshness of the seafood, the creative menu, and the excellent service. Here are some highlights from customer reviews:

  • “The sushi at Blue Fish is some of the best I’ve had in Dallas. The happy hour deals make it even better!”
  • “The oyster bar is fantastic – the oysters are always fresh, and the atmosphere is great for after-work drinks.”
  • “Amazing food and drinks. Love the crispy rice with spicy tuna. Can’t wait to join the happy hour again!”

With a stellar rating, it’s no wonder Blue Fish has become a favorite for those seeking great food, drink, and atmosphere.

Why Choose Blue Fish Restaurant for Happy Hour?

Here are some reasons why Blue Fish should be your go-to spot for happy hour:

  • Affordable Prices: Enjoy premium sushi and cocktails without breaking the bank.
  • Great Atmosphere: Whether you’re sitting at the bar or dining in the main room, the vibe is always upbeat.
  • Location: With locations in Dallas and Jacksonville, Blue Fish is easy to access for a quick after-work bite or dinner.
  • Fresh Seafood: The restaurant is known for serving the freshest sushi, oysters, and sashimi.

What to Expect: Atmosphere and Dining Experience

At Blue Fish, the dining experience is all about comfort and enjoyment. With a spacious bar, stylish seating, and a dining room perfect for group outings or date nights, it’s easy to see why this restaurant is a local favorite. The service is friendly, and the vibe is casual yet sophisticated.

Lunch and Dinner Specials at Blue Fish

Aside from happy hour, Blue Fish offers great deals for both lunch and dinner. You can explore their menu for additional specials on sushi, sashimi, and other seafood dishes. The restaurant is open seven days a week, so you can enjoy fresh seafood any day.

Blue Fish Lunch Specials:

  • Bento Boxes: Starting at $12, includes sushi, rice, and an appetizer.
  • Sashimi Combo: A selection of fresh sashimi served with a side salad, starting at $15.

Blue Fish Dinner Specials:

  • Sushi Platter: A mix of your favorite sushi rolls, starting at $22.
  • Oyster Bar Specials: Fresh oysters on the half shell, starting at $12 for a half-dozen.

Blue Fish Restaurant Locations

Blue Fish Restaurant has several locations, including:

  • Dallas: 3519 Greenville Ave, Dallas, TX.
  • Allen: 850 W Stacy Rd, Allen, TX.
  • Jacksonville: 5822 University Blvd, Jacksonville, FL.

No matter which location you visit, you can always expect the same high-quality food and service.

How to Join the Happy Hour at Blue Fish

Joining the happy hour is easy. Simply visit any Blue Fish location during happy hour hours, grab a seat at the bar, and choose from the happy hour menu. Whether you’re in the mood for sushi, rolls, or cocktails, there’s something for everyone.

See the Latest Menu at Blue Fish

For the most up-to-date offerings, you can always check out the Blue Fish Happy Hour Menu online. See the latest menu to explore their rotating specials and seasonal items.

Conclusion

Whether you’re a sushi lover or a fan of fresh seafood, Blue Fish Restaurant offers a happy hour experience like no other. From sushi and oysters to signature cocktails, every visit promises great food, good drinks, and unbeatable prices. So why wait? Head to 3519 Greenville Ave or another nearby Blue Fish location and join the happy hour crowd today!
